hooks.name: Start live diff on file save
hooks.description: On file save, use hunk-review.nvim if nvim is installed, otherwise hunk --watch. Both are idempotent.

action.command: command -v drovr >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ "${HERDR_ENV:-0}" = "1" ] && { if command -v nvim >/dev/null 2>&1; then drovr review start >/dev/null 2>&1; elif command -v hunk >/dev/null 2>&1; then drovr diff start >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; } || true
